notes:
- Every notification opens inside the app: a media row opens the real title sheet, an activity opens the profile comment thread, and a forum thread opens a read-only page with the comment the notification is about followed by its newest comments. The inbox no longer hands those targets to a browser.
- The Android permission is asked for where it belongs: Settings > Notifications reports the Android 13 runtime permission, the app switch and this channel, asks there when it can, sends a test post, and opens the system page otherwise. There is still no background worker or push service.
- The bell can disappear without losing the inbox: Settings > Library > Top bar hides the Home bell, while Settings > Notifications keeps an Open notification centre button as the way back.
- Reopening the inbox is not a reload: the cached first page is reused, older pages already on screen stay, and an explicit Refresh action sits beside pull-to-refresh. Refreshing still asks AniList and replaces the snapshot.
